UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores public profile information for a user, including their game balance and daily coin collection status.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the profile was created.

lastCoinCollection.description: Timestamp of when the user last collected their daily coins.

UserBet.title: UserBet
UserBet.description: Represents a single bet placed by a user.

gameId.description: The ID of the game the bet is on. For parlays, this is a comma-separated list of game IDs.

userId.description: The ID of the user who placed the bet.

pick.description: The user's selection. For parlays, this is a summary like '4-Leg Parlay'.

matchup.description: The matchup string for single bets, e.g., 'Team A @ Team B'.

odds.description: The American odds for the bet.

potentialWinnings.description: How much the user stands to win.

commenceTime.description: The start time of the game, snapshotted at time of bet placement.

legs.description: An array of individual bet legs for a parlay.

DailyGame.title: DailyGame
DailyGame.description: Represents the odds for a specific upcoming game fetched daily from the API.

commenceTime.description: The timestamp when the game is scheduled to start. Must be a Datetime string

bookmakerOdds.description: Array of odds from different bookmakers, stored as JSON strings.

CompletedGame.title: CompletedGame
CompletedGame.description: Represents the final scores of a completed game, fetched to check results.

commenceTime.description: The timestamp when the game started. Must be a Datetime string

homeScore.description: Final score of the home team.

awayScore.description: Final score of the away team.

SystemStatus.title: SystemStatus
SystemStatus.description: Stores system-wide status information, like the last time daily data was fetched.

last_updated_date.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the daily data was last successfully fetched and saved.

TeamRanking.title: TeamRanking
TeamRanking.description: Represents a single team's rank and conference in a poll (e.g., AP Top 25).

teamName.description: The full name of the team.

/daily_games/{gameId}.description: Stores odds for upcoming games. Clients write directly to this collection after fetching from an external API.

/completed_games/{gameId}.description: Stores final scores for completed games. Clients write directly to this collection.

/system/{statusId}.description: Stores system-wide status information. Only a single document with ID 'status' is expected.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile data, including their coin balance.

/users/{userId}/bets/{betId}.description: Subcollection for storing bets placed by a specific user.

/rankings/{teamName}.description: Stores the weekly Top 25 rankings for teams. The document ID is the team's full name.
